title: Construction of a translational whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic model to investigate the biodistribution of lipid nanoparticle-based mRNA therapeutics for intracellular protein targets.
caption: Global sensitivity analysis using the PRCC method. ( A ) Ranking of the negatively correlated parameters for the liver protein profile, ( B ) Ranking of the positively correlated parameters for the liver protein profiles, ( C ) ranking of negatively correlated parameters for the liver mRNA profiles, ( D ) positive correlation ranking for the liver mRNA profiles. mRNA dose and infusion time are fixed to 2 mg/kg and 10 min respectively
